title: 1× exception raised without `from` in except block (W0707, first at line 83)
detail: At 1 location(s) (first at line 83), a new exception is raised inside an `except` block without `raise ... from original_exc`. This discards the original traceback and makes debugging harder. Fix: `raise NewExc(...) from exc` to preserve the chain.

title: Builtin `filter` shadowed by local variable (W0622)
detail: Local variable(s) at line 38 shadow the builtin(s) filter. If the builtin is needed elsewhere in the same scope, the shadowing causes a confusing `TypeError` or silent misbehavior. Fix: rename the local variable to avoid shadowing.
